description: This file defines a Symfony console command class 'AddRolePermissionCommand' used to add permissions for user roles to data groups within the OrangeHRM system. It includes configuration, interaction, execution, and helper methods for managing role permissions via command-line operations.

classes.name: AddRolePermissionCommand
classes.description: Symfony console command for adding role permissions to data groups in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command description, arguments, and options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command with SymfonyStyle for console I/O.

methods.name: interact
methods.description: Handles user prompts to gather command input interactively.

methods.name: getDataGroupAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates an autocompleter question for selecting data groups.

methods.name: getUserRoleAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates an autocompleter question for selecting user roles.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the core logic to add role permissions, either real or simulated.

methods.name: printDataGroupPermissionTable
methods.description: Displays a table of current data group permissions.

methods.name: printDataGroupPermissionSQL
methods.description: Outputs sample SQL scripts that replicate the permission insertion.

methods.name: printBlock
methods.description: Outputs a text block message in the console with emphasis.
